content: Abiyam, ajeǧid x temmurt n Yahuda
Deg useggʷas wiss tmenṭac n ujeǧid Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ, idweř Abiyam d ajeǧid x Yahuda.
Netta iḥkem třata n iseggʷusa di Urcalim. Yemmas qqaren as Maɛka, yeǧis n Abicalum.
Netta yuyur di marra ddnub n babas nni tuɣa igga qbeř nnes uca uř nnes war tuɣi ca icḍar ɣar SIDI, AREBBI nnes, am wuř n babas Dawud.
Maca di ṭṭweɛ n Dawud iwca as SIDI, AREBBI nnes, ijj n řefnar di Urcalim umi igga ad issekkar mmis awarni as, u umi igga ad teqqim tbedd Urcalim,
maɣar Dawud tuɣa igga min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin n SIDI u netta tuɣa war iḥeyyed di marra tudart nnes x marra min i d as yumur Netta, mɣir di tmesřact n Uriya, Aḥitti.
Tuɣa din amenɣi jar Raḥabɛam d Yarubɛam, marra ussan n tudart nnes.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Abiyam d marra min igga, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Yahuda? Tuɣa din ɛawed amenɣi jar Abiyam d Yarubɛam.
Abiyam igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes. Neḍřen t di tendint n Dawud. Mmis Asa idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Asa, ajeǧid x temmurt n Yahuda
Deg useggʷas wiss ɛicrin n Yarubɛam, ajeǧid n Israil, idweř Asa d ajeǧid x Yahuda.
Netta iḥkem waḥit u-rebɛin n iseggʷusa di Urcalim. Ḥennas qqaren as Maɛka, yeǧis n Abicalum.
Asa igga min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin n SIDI, am igga babas Dawud.
Netta issuffeɣ imetleyyen zi temmurt uca iḥeyyed marra imeyḍa n l’aṣnam nsen i tuɣa ggin řejdud nnes.
Netta issḥeyyed uřa d ḥennas Maɛka zi jjehd nnes, maɣar nettat tuɣa tegga ijj n řexyař d jjɛifect i trebbit n cwarti. Asa iqess jjɛifect nnes uca isscemḍ i-tt ɣar teɣzart n Qidrun.
War ttwaḥeyydent řegɛudi, maca uř n Asa tuɣa icḍar nican i SIDI, marra ussan n tudart nnes.
Netta yiwi tiwhibin iqeddsen n babas uřa d tiwhibin nni issqeddes netta s yixef nnes di Taddart n SIDI: nnuqart d wureɣ d řeqcuɛ nneɣni.
Tuɣa din amenɣi jar Asa d Baɛca, ajeǧid n Israil, marra ussan nsen.
Baɛca, ajeǧid n Israil, igeɛɛed ɣar umenɣi ḍidd i Yahuda uca ibna Rama, ḥima war ittejji uřa d ijj ad yuyur ɣar Asa, ḥima ad ɣares dd-yas.

Xenni iksi Asa marra nnuqart d wureɣ i tuɣa iqqimen deg ixxamen n txubay n Taddart n SIDI uřa d txubay n taddart n ujeǧid, uca isellem marra aya i imsexxaren nnes. Uca ajeǧid Asa issekk i-ten ɣar Binhadad, mmis n Tabrimun, mmis n Ḥazyun, ajeǧid n Aram, wenni tuɣa izeddɣen di Dimacq, ḥima ad yini:
“Aqa din ijj n řɛahd jar ayi d cek, jar baba d babac. Xzar necc ad ac dd-ssekkeɣ ict n terzeft n nnuqart d wureɣ. Ruḥ, fsi řɛahd nnec ak-d Baɛca, ajeǧid n Israil, maḥend ad ikkar ad xafi iggʷej.”
Binhadad isřa ɣar ujeǧid Asa uca issekk ikumandaren n řɛeskar nnes ɣar tneddam n Israil. Netta iɣřeb x Ɛiyun d Dan d Abal-Bayt-Maɛka d marra Kinnarut. Aqa issekk i-ten ɣar marra tammurt n Naftali.
Umi Baɛca isřa x uya, imsar, aqa netta issbedd di řebni n Rama uca iqqim izeddeɣ di Tirṣa.
Ajeǧid Asa ijja ad barrḥen di marra Yahuda, war ittɣimi ḥed, ḥima nitni ad kksen iẓra zi Rama d ukeccuḍ i zi tuɣa ibenna Baɛca. U s man aya ibna ujeǧid Asa tandint n Jibɛa di Binyamin d Miṣfa.

Imezruyen iqqimen n Asa, marra timegga nnes imeḥḍen d marra min igga uřa d tineddam nni ibna, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Yahuda? Maca umi iwsar, ihřec netta zeg iḍaren nnes s tnayen.
Asa igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes. Netta ittwanḍeř jar řejdud nnes di tendint n babas Dawud. Mmis Yahucafaṭ idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Nadab, ajeǧid x temmurt n Israil
Nadab, mmis n Yarubɛam, idweř d ajeǧid x Israil deg useggʷas wiss tnayen n Asa, ajeǧid n Yahuda. Netta iḥkem tnayen n iseggʷusa x Israil.
Netta igga min iǧan d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin n SIDI uca yuyur deg webrid n babas u di ddnub nnes i zi yarra Israil ad ixḍa.
Baɛca, mmis n Abiya, zi taddart n Issakar, igga xas ict n tmeɛmuč u Baɛca iɣřeb xas di Jibbatun nni iǧan n Ifilisṭiniyyen, umi Nadab d marra Israil tuɣa innḍen i Jibbatun.
Inɣa i-t Baɛca deg useggʷas wiss třata n Asa, ajeǧid n Yahuda, u netta idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.

Umi idweř netta d ajeǧid, imsar, aqa iqḍa x marra taddart n Yarubɛam. Uřa d ca n Yarubɛam nni yarrin nnefs, war t ijji ad iqqim iddar, ařami t iteḥḥa ɛlaḥsab awař n SIDI nni tuɣa issiweř s uqemmum n umsexxar nnes Axiya, Aciluni,
di ssibbet n ddnub n Yarubɛam i zi ixḍa netta u i zi yarra Israil ad ixḍa s tmegga nnes ixewwjen i zi isɛar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Nadab, d marra min igga, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Israil?
Tuɣa din amenɣi jar Asa d Baɛca, ajeǧid n Israil, marra ussan nsen.
Baɛsa, ajeǧid n Israil
Deg useggʷas wiss třata n ujeǧid Asa, ajeǧid n Yahuda, idweř Baɛca, mmis n Axiya, d ajeǧid x marra Israil di Tirṣa, u netta iḥkem arebɛa u-ɛicrin n iseggʷusa.
Netta igga min iǧan d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin n SIDI u yuyur deg webrid n Yarubɛam u di ddnub nnes i zi yarra Israil ad ixḍa.
